blocks.text: From attending dawn Mass and sharing puto and sikwate to exchanging gifts and gathering around a table of Cebuano favorites, Christmas in Cebu is shaped by traditions that families carry from one generation to the next. While shopping habits, decorations and celebrations have adapted to modern lifestyles, many Cebuanos continue to find meaning in the familiar rituals that bring them together each December. For Cebuano households, Christmas is not only a date on the calendar but a season of preparation, reunion and shared memories.
